title: Terminal Bed Cleaning and Room Sanitization
content:
SOP: Terminal Bed Cleaning and Room Sanitization (SOP-FAC-001)
DEPARTMENT: Facility Management
VERSION: 1.7
ROLES: housekeeping, nurse
PURPOSE: Ultraviolet surface disinfection and 45-minute bed turnaround.
STEPS:
Step 1: Execute phase 1 of Terminal Bed Cleaning and Room Sanitization in full compliance with Facility Management hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 2: Execute phase 2 of Terminal Bed Cleaning and Room Sanitization in full compliance with Facility Management hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 3: Execute phase 3 of Terminal Bed Cleaning and Room Sanitization in full compliance with Facility Management hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 4: Execute phase 4 of Terminal Bed Cleaning and Room Sanitization in full compliance with Facility Management hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 5: Execute phase 5 of Terminal Bed Cleaning and Room Sanitization in full compliance with Facility Management hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
- [BLOCKER] System connectivity or missing documentation in Facility Management.
- [BLOCKER] Bed, reagent, medication, or personnel resource constraints during peak hours.
- [ESCALATION] Delays exceeding 2 hours must be escalated to the Operations Manager.
- [ESCALATION] Clinical complications or safety hazards must be escalated immediately to Clinical Review.
source_citation: SOP-FAC-001 Terminal Bed Cleaning and Room Sanitization v1.7, Section 4
